roblox-studio.label: Roblox Studio (official MCP)
roblox-studio.notes: Install from https://github.com/Roblox/studio-rust-mcp-server (Releases). Run the installer once; it adds the Studio plugin. Then Studio must be open with a place loaded. Tools: run_code, insert_model.

unreal-engine.label: Unreal Engine 5 (UnrealMCP plugin)
unreal-engine.notes: Install https://github.com/chongdashu/unreal-mcp (or any Unreal MCP server). Enable the plugin in your UE 5.x project, start the editor, then enable this.

custom-http.label: Custom MCP (Streamable HTTP)
custom-http.notes: Any MCP server exposing Streamable HTTP.
